principles: Immutable master copy is never rewritten to accommodate visuals.
Text-heavy diagrams are rendered as HTML/CSS/SVG, not raster images with embedded text.
Real places use real photography; do not generate fake documentary location photos.
Historical artifacts use real open-access/public-domain museum imagery where the master asks for an authentic ancient image.
Third-party brands default to text/neutral reference; actual logos/screenshots require Step 15 approval.
Generated imagery uses one coherent MIYU editorial art direction.
Every Visual Stop has a mobile behavior and accessible alternative text.
RU and EN reuse the same visual asset where possible; localized labels remain live text.
